title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Resumes Serialization on June 29
content: Shueisha will publish the manga's 39th compiled book volume, its first volume in 22 months, on July 3. Shueisha published chapters 401 to 410 of the manga in its Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from issue 45 of 2024 to issue two of 2025.
